blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) said vlogger or businessman Norman Mangusin, also known as “Francis Leo Marcos,” was arrested on Monday afternoon over three counts of cyberlibel. He remains in the custody of the Criminal Investigation and Detection Group (CIDG), with bail set at P30,000 for each count.
